queries: WITH timing_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS average_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS average_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals) SELECT AVG(t.average_ownership) AS mean_timing_ownership, AVG(t.average_ownership - o.average_ownership) AS mean_amount_above_average FROM timing_averages t CROSS JOIN overall_average o WHERE t.average_ownership > o.average_ownership;

assumptions.assumption: “Above average” uses the average ownership across records with nonmissing ownership; missing announcement timing forms its own group.

alternatives.interpretation: “Above average” means above the equally weighted mean of the timing groups’ average ownership.
